decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting serves long defense procurement and refit cycles in which suppliers must provide long-term availability, so the firm is likely to keep the line even though it sits outside the core offer.

The medical examination light uses the firm's established lighting competence for institutional customers, and with healthcare demand strong after the pandemic the firm is unlikely to withdraw it, though regulatory costs for medical devices pose some risk.
Certified explosion-proof LED luminaires are a durable, high-margin industrial line that fits the firm's energy-efficiency strategy.

Office luminaires face weaker demand from hybrid work and refresh cycles that run toward successor models, but the pendant office luminaire is close to the core offer and probably still sells to commercial projects.
The premium pendant line has several models and supports the firm's high-end architectural positioning, so the firm is likely to keep it and update it rather than drop it.
